Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class MatchStatistics

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.MatchStatistics
public class MatchStatistics extends Object
Provides statistical analysis of match collections. Calculates medians, averages, distributions, and other statistical metrics.

This class extracts statistical operations that were previously embedded in ActionResult.

Since:
2.0
